source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactivity of Group 2 (PDF 5-6).

blocks.text: Group 2 anasir ki reactivity un ki electronic configuration se samajh aati hai. Yeh apne do bairooni electrons (ns2) kho kar mustahkam M2+ ions banate hain, jis se aasani se react karte hain. Reactivity beryllium se barium tak barhti hai kyunke atoms bare hote, shielding barhti aur ionization energy ghat'ti hai, is liye electrons aasani se nikalte hain.

blocks.alt: Atoms Be, Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba ke paanch surmai daire, metallic radius ke paimane par, 112, 160, 197, 215 aur 222 pm, aur un ke neeche kaafi chhote rangeen M2+ ions, 31, 65, 99, 113 aur 135 pm. Teer batata hai ke baen se daen group mein neeche jana hai.
blocks.caption: Group 2 atoms aur ions ke nisbati size (Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Group 2 mein neeche har atom mein electrons ka aik khol (shell) zyada hota hai, is liye metallic radius beryllium ke 112 pm se barium ke 222 pm tak barhta hai. Bahar ke ns2 electrons nucleus se door aur zyada shielded hote hain, is liye pehli aur doosri ionization energy kam hoti aur anasir zyada reactive hote hain. Har atom do bairooni electrons kho kar M2+ ion banata hai jo atom se kaafi chhota hai kyunke poora khol chala jata hai; ions bhi group mein neeche barhte hain, Be2+ ke 31 pm se Ba2+ ke 135 pm tak.

blocks.title: Group 2 ka reactivity series
blocks.text: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba: beryllium sab se kam aur barium sab se zyada reactive unsar hai.

blocks.prompt: Mg, Ba aur Ca ko barhti reactivity ki tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: Mg < Ca < Ba, group mein un ki jagah ke mutabiq.

items: Group 2 dhaatein do electrons kho kar M2+ ions banati hain.
Reactivity group mein neeche barhti: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba.
